findings.title: Weak Monitoring Account Authentication
findings.recommendation: Use strong passwords and enable multifactor authentication where supported.

findings.title: Insecure Wi-Fi Configuration
findings.recommendation: Use secure Wi-Fi authentication and update network security settings.

findings.title: Outdated Monitoring Device Firmware
findings.recommendation: Apply vendor-supported firmware updates and restrict unnecessary access.

findings.title: Excessive Monitoring Account Permissions
findings.recommendation: Apply least-privilege access and review user permissions.

findings.title: Inadequate Network Segmentation
findings.recommendation: Segment energy monitoring devices and restrict unnecessary network communication.
